title: CHORDS (keyboard chord modes)
author: stephen
description: The Digitone II's chord modes for the Digitone mk1 and Digitone Keys, on a third AMP page, Chords: MODE (OFF, or CHORD ROOT, CENTER or SPREAD with BASS OCT 0 to -3), SHAP (eight shapes, also on TRIG 1-8 while the page shows: 1-3-5, 1-3-5-7 ... in a scale, MAJ, MIN, 7TH ... on chromatic) and CENT (the center position). With MODE on, each single-note trig on the track plays that chord from the track's keyboard ROOT and SCALE; trigs that hold a chord play as stored. The sequencer's trigs only for now, not the TRIG keys played live. Needs core-dn1 3.3 and seq-events.
